modules-model-for-open-datum-signing.text: No new module; responsibilities change in place, and open-datum still depends on the registry library, never the reverse.

open-datum-command-line.text: The open-datum parser reads the signer only through the shared write reader, and keeps its own refusals for previews and inspect.

open-datum-entry-commands.text: The entry commands gain no signing code; only their own receipt fields and events learn to say staged.

command-reference-and-guides.text: The settings table names the open-datum writes per flag, bound to each help by the documented flags check.
